text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! I heard you're a good drawer!
The
Demon Queen Windy orders you to
draw me and
my minions!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You'd better make us look extra cool
and evil!
'Cause it's goin' up on the wall
in my room, got
it?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...How am I supposed to sleep like this?!
I can't
believe I got a req from one of my
favs!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And she called me a "good drawer"!
That's like
the highest praise a fanartist
could ever get! I'm
throwing my whole
heart into the pic first thing
tomorrow
morning!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Sigh... ♪ What kind of pose should I draw them in? The Demon Queen... and her loyal servants...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Rise again, Minion #2!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Kyaa! The MOE! I can't sleep on this!!! AaaAAAAadfhgk, thanks for my lifeee!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You, you did it! With this new undead
servant,
you're one step closer to your
nefarious goals, my
liege.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Bwhaha! Let's go and fill the world with
devilish
deeds! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Go forth, Dot-o'-Lantern! Jiangshi! I
expect you
to bring back trick-or-treat
hauls worthy of your
queen!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Anything for you, my queeeen! I love youuu! You can trick me any tiiime!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what the heck are you doing?!
Quit gushing
and go be evil!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, r-right! Sorry! You were so radiant, I
couldn't
help myself!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well, y-you're still new to being a villain.
It's, um,
it's completely normal to make
a few mistakes
while you're learning...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Like I care about that! C'mon, you dumb
idiots!
You're MY minions, so act like it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Guwaaah! You're too cute when you're
angry
omgomgaaaaadsdhk help no omg
my heart aaa I
CAAAN'T! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WHOA?! Why'd she drop dead again?! I just raised that moron!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eep! M-my liege, please! I beg your
forgiveness!
I-I'm sure she just needs a
little time to adjust,
that's all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: SHUT UP! I don't care—that stupid fangirl's gettin' chomped!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Creeeak... Snap!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah?! My queen, watch ouuut!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeep?! T-the sign fell right on her! The
poor
jiangshi...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
She sacrificed herself to push me out of
the way...
Hey. I said HEY! W-wake up!
C'mon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My liege... Are you... o...kay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What are you, stupid?! Why are you worried about me? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I was gonna give you a chomping, but...
Urrrgh,
forget it! I don't feel like biting
you anymore!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Be-because you're dumb and annoying, I
mean!
I'm not crying! Why would I be
sad you got hurt?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My liege... Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I hear voices echoing in the darkness...
How
tragically beautiful... Oh nooo, they
sound so
sweet!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uraaaaaah! This is no time to be lying
around
dead! I've got simping to do!

text_block_list.name: Queen & Lantern
text_block_list.text:
Y-you!
Jiangshiiiii!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My liege! Doto! Look, I'm right as rain!
You don't
need to worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So please put some smiles back on your
beautiful
faces! I need my oshis to be
happy—it's literally
life or death!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! I don't even know what to make
of you
anymore. But if you're alive, then
get up and do
your job! C'mon, we're
leaving!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...And that's when I woke up. What a
dream,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I just wish it hadn't been quite so self-insert-y. Like I could never interact with my oshis like that! And just imagine what they might've done if I'd been a ghost and they had no idea I was watching!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...You weren't as useless as I thought. I
won't
forget your sacrifice.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I'll treat my other minion
better. I'll give
her the care I wasn't able
to give you. B-but just a little!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dot-o'-Lantern! Quit crying
already! You've
still got me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My... My liege!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It'll all be okay. We can still spread
evil—just the
two of us. So... so shut up
and follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Of course! I, um... I know I'm not
the most
reliable, but I promise I'll do
my very best for you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(What a beautiful pair... My heart feels...
so
free...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A wisp of light just... le-left the
jiangshi's
body?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...And there she goes, ascending into the
sky. Her
body's got such a peaceful
smile on its face...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...And that's when I woke up. What a
dream,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I just wish it hadn't been quite so self-insert-y. Like I could never interact with my oshis like that! And just imagine what they might've done if I'd been a ghost and they had no idea I was watching!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Uwaaaaaah! You dumb, stupid idiooot!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...My liege. Are you feeling a little
better now?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. That jiangshi... She was a weirdo,
but she
wasn't bad.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So for her sake, I've gotta pull myself
together
and be strong!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Let's conquer the world and fill it
with
fear! It's what she would have
wanted.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Right behind you! I'm sure the jiangshi
is
watching us from her grave with a
smile!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I see the two of them run into the
distance, side
by side. There for each
other, together
evermore...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...And that's when I woke up. What a
dream,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I just wish it hadn't been quite so self-insert-y. Like I could never interact with my oshis like that! And just imagine what they might've done if I'd been a ghost and they had no idea I was watching!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But still, it definitely gave me some good material! It was the perfect inspiration for Windy's picture!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whiiich I've gotta go offer up to her
Demonic
Majesty! I'll catch you later,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the sound of it, she's had a fun
Halloween
season, and that's what
counts!
